incentives.resetTitle: Reset truck rates to UWC spec?
incentives.resetBody: Reset all truck rates to UWC spec defaults? This overwrites current rate values (peak & off-peak claim, daily deduction, max load) for all trucks with the authoritative values from docs/uwc-spec.json. Audit-logged. Rate values take effect tomorrow (MYT); max load applies immediately.
incentives.stagingWarning: Rate changes take effect tomorrow (MYT) — today's assignments and running trips keep today's rates.
incentives.pointsStagingWarning: Point changes take effect tomorrow (MYT) — today's assignments and running trips keep today's points.
incentives.zoneWideNote: Applies to every location in the zone.
incentives.holidaysLoadError: Could not load the holiday calendar.
incentives.holidayBanner: Trips picked up on a listed date pay the off-peak rate all day.
incentives.holidayValidation: Both the date and the holiday name are required.
incentives.removeHolidayBody: Remove {{name}} ({{date}}) from the calendar? Deliveries confirmed that day will pay the peak rate instead of the off-peak rate. Already-completed trips keep their finalized pay. Audit-logged.
incentives.formulaNote: The deduction comes off the day's total points, once per driver per day, and never takes the total below zero.
incentives.rulesLoadError: Could not load the pay rules from the server.
incentives.ruleZonePoints: Points count per drop, per zone, per day, per driver. The first delivery into a zone that day earns that zone's full points; every later delivery into the same zone earns the flat repeat score of {{repeat}}.
incentives.ruleDeduction: The day's points are totalled first, then the truck's Daily Deduction Points are subtracted once, floored at zero. A low-scoring first drop does not waste the deduction — the remainder carries to the next delivery that day.
incentives.rulePay: Pay = the day's points after the deduction × the truck's rate for that day's band.
incentives.ruleAnchor: Both the rate band and the incentive day are read from the DELIVERY CONFIRM time, not the pickup time. A run that starts in one band and confirms in another is paid at the confirm.
incentives.ruleReset: The incentive day resets at {{hour}} Malaysia time.
incentives.ruleInterplant: Interplant work is paid in whole round trips: the day's interplant points are halved and rounded down, so a single unpaired leg pays nothing until its return completes the pair.
incentives.offPeakCardBody: Everything else: weekdays before {{start}} and from {{end}}, all day Saturday and Sunday, and any date on UWC's holiday calendar.
incentives.ratesPerTruckNote: Each truck carries its own peak and off-peak rate — see Truck Claim Rates.

trips.cancelBody: Cancel booking {{ticket}}? The requestor keeps the record, but the trip will not be dispatched. This cannot be undone.
trips.abortBody: Abort trip {{ticket}}? Use this only when the driver can't finish it (e.g. they've departed). Stops already delivered keep their pay — the amount goes to incentive approval as usual. Stops not delivered are not paid and must be re-booked. If nothing was delivered yet, the trip is simply cancelled. Either way the truck is freed for dispatch. This cannot be undone.
trips.unassignBody: Remove {{name}} from trip {{ticket}}? The trip returns to Pending and re-enters the dispatch flow (auto-dispatch may pick it up again). The driver will be notified.
trips.bulkRejectBody: Reject the {{count}} selected pending bookings? Each requestor is notified. This cannot be undone.

pay.approvedBody: You verified this report. If you close it with "Do not return", the driver is paid for this stop at the normal rate — the same as a delivery.
pay.notApprovedBody: Verify first if this was a genuine failed delivery. Without a verify, closing this report pays the driver nothing for this stop.
pay.vetoedTitle: No pay — a report on this stop was rejected
pay.vetoedBody: Another report on this stop was rejected, and a rejection is final. Verifying this one will NOT pay the driver for this stop — the rejection wins. Rejections cannot be undone; correcting this needs the amount edit at approval.
pay.noStopBody: This report is not attached to a stop the driver reached, so verifying it pays nothing. A stop he never got to earns no incentive.

exception.verify: Verify — approve pay for this stop
exception.verifyHint: Confirms the driver really could not deliver. This is the pay decision: the stop is then paid at the normal rate once you close the report with "Do not return".
exception.reject: Reject — no pay for this stop
exception.rejectHint: The driver is not paid for this stop. FINAL — a rejection cannot be undone, and it blocks pay for this stop even if another report on it is approved later. A note is required.
exception.resume: Do not return — close this stop
exception.resumeHintVerified: The driver carries on without coming back. This stop is PAID, because you verified it.
exception.resumeHintUnverified: The driver carries on without coming back. This stop is NOT paid — you have not verified it. Use this to get a stuck truck moving.
exception.retryHint: Settles nothing and pays nothing. The stop stays open so the driver can still deliver it, and it is paid normally when he does.
exception.noteRequired: A note is required for this action.
exception.conflictRefreshed: This exception changed — refreshed to the latest. Please review and retry.

outcome.rejectedBody: This stop will not be paid. A rejection is final and cannot be undone here. If you think it is wrong, call the office.
outcome.resolvedBody: Nothing further for you on this stop.
outcome.noReasonGiven: No reason was given. Call the office if you need one.
